title.zh: v2.0.19 三项使用反馈：钢琴卷帘默认满宽（并可全屏/收起/关闭）、GS-1 与换音色的卡顿根因、轨道检查器改成分类 tab
title.en: v2.0.19 Three pieces of feedback from real use: the piano roll fills the width by default (and can go fullscreen, collapse or close), the root causes behind the GS-1 and timbre-switch stalls, and a tabbed track inspector

highlights.zh: **钢琴卷帘只有屏幕 1/3 宽——因为格子宽度是写死的像素**。第一版用 `ZOOMS = [14, 20, 26, …]` 直接当格子宽度，于是音符网格永远是 `步数 × 26px`：16 步就是 416px，在 1440px 的屏幕上正好约 1/3，抽屉剩下的地方全空着。现在缩放是**相对容器宽度的倍数**（用 `ResizeObserver` 量抽屉宽度再算格子宽），默认 1× 就是**铺满**，缩放按钮从 0.5× 到 2× 在此基础上放大缩小；格子宽有 10px 下限（32 步在窄屏上不会被压成看不见）。新增两个状态：**全屏**（`fixed inset-0`，带安全区内边距，Esc 先退全屏再关面板，因为那是更小的一步）与**收起**（只留工具栏——轨选择、缩放、移调、关闭都还在，编辑区卸载）。E2E 量的是几何：网格宽度必须 ≥ 抽屉宽度 − 60px、全屏盒子必须覆盖视口、收起后编辑区必须消失而工具栏必须还在。
highlights.en: **The piano roll was about a third of the screen because its cell width was a hard-coded pixel size.** The first version used `ZOOMS = [14, 20, 26, …]` as the cell width directly, so the note grid was always `steps × 26px` — 416 px for a 16-step pattern, almost exactly a third of a 1440 px screen, with the rest of the drawer empty. Zoom is now a **factor on a cell width derived from the measured container** (a `ResizeObserver` watches the drawer), so the default 1× **fills**…

highlights.zh: **GS-1 开关与播放中换音色的卡顿，根因有三个，都在主线程的生命周期上**。① **每次换音色都在重建 host**：`ensureTrack`/`tryPlay` 把「乐器名不同」当成「拆掉这个 slot、重新加载一个 host」，于是从一个 GS-1 patch 换到另一个，会先销毁一个完全可用的 worklet、让接下来几个音**回退到原生引擎**、等新 host 编译完再切回来——听感就是「换音色没反应，过一会儿才变」。host 与乐器无关（patch 只是一组参数），现在**就地把新 patch 推给同一个 host**；新乐器若没有 GS-1 patch（例如钢琴这类刻意保留原生的），也只是**不用**它发声，host 仍然留着，切回来是即时的。② **关闭 GS-1 时同步销毁**：`releaseAll()` + `dispose()` 原本都写在点击处理里，正在播放时等于在主线程上拆掉每个 worklet 节点并释放 WASM——这就是「一切就像卡住」。现在**先静音、后释放**：`releaseAll()` 立即执行（声…
highlights.en: **The stalls around the GS-1 switch and around switching timbre during playback have three root causes, all of them main-thread lifecycle work.** (1) **Every timbre change rebuilt the host**: `ensureTrack`/`tryPlay` treated "a different instrument" as "tear this slot down and load another host", so switching from one GS-1 patch to another disposed a perfectly usable worklet, played the next notes on the **native** engine while the replacement compiled, and only then switched…

highlights.zh: **一个可复用的测量脚本，因为「卡」不能靠读代码断言**：`scripts/measure_interaction_latency.mjs` 在真实浏览器里量每个交互的 **点击→DOM 真的反映变化** 的延迟，以及期间主线程的 **long task**（>50ms 的阻塞；那正是「卡住」的感觉，也是会饿死调度器前瞻的东西）。第一次写它时我把固定 `setTimeout` 当成 settle，于是把一个几毫秒的状态翻转量成了 8 秒——现在的 inspect 等的是**可观测状态**（`aria-pressed` 翻转、选项 `aria-selected` 变 true、格子 `aria-selected` 改变）。本机（无头 Chromium，桌面视口，同一脚本同一条件）修复前后：**GS-1 关 119.5 → 38.8 ms、开 71.5 → 23.9 ms**（约 3 倍）；**换音色 81/160/215/108 → 89/81/63/59 ms**（最差那个从 215 ms 降到 63 ms）；切一步 59.6 → 45.1 m…
highlights.en: **A reusable probe, because "it stutters" cannot be asserted by reading code.** `scripts/measure_interaction_latency.mjs` measures, in a real browser, each interaction's **click → the DOM actually reflecting it** latency plus the main thread's **long tasks** during it (>50 ms of blocking is what "stuck" feels like, and it is what starves the scheduler's lookahead). The first version of the probe used a fixed `setTimeout` as its settle, which is how it reported eight seconds…
